A '''silk belt''' was a [[belt]] made of [[Silk/Legends|silk]]. Professional [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]] wore one while disguised as the servant [[Arden (Rydonni Prime)|Arden]]. He later used to same belt to gag [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kalieva K'ntarr]].<ref name="Easy Credits">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
